name: WOL Forwarder
description: Forward Wake-on-LAN (WOL) requests and send magic packets on your LAN.
options_description: wol_port: UDP port to send magic packets to (usually 9). http_port: port for the HTTP API (add-on uses host network). log_to_file: when true, logs are written to log_file in your config folder. allowed_ips: optional list of client IPs allowed to call the HTTP API (empty = allow all).
author: erkr
